sentences.speaker: Maya
sentences.text: Anyone who has walked past Larch Street lately has noticed the gates are open again.

sentences.speaker: Owen
sentences.text: Absolutely, the allotment society reopened the site on Saturday after a long winter closure.

sentences.speaker: Maya
sentences.text: Crowds turned up with spades, seed trays and a surprising number of thermoses.

sentences.speaker: Owen
sentences.text: Deborah Hale, who has run plot nine for years, said the soil was still cold.

sentences.speaker: Maya
sentences.text: Apparently the shared water tank had frozen solid over January, so volunteers spent the morning thawing it.

sentences.speaker: Owen
sentences.text: Coffee and biscuits were on offer in the old shed.

sentences.speaker: Maya
sentences.text: Well, the society is asking newcomers to sign up for a plot before the end of March.

sentences.speaker: Owen
sentences.text: Fees are modest, and there is a waiting list for the larger beds near the hedge.

sentences.speaker: Maya
sentences.text: Gardeners who want to help with the compost bins can just turn up on Thursday evenings.

sentences.speaker: Owen
sentences.text: Families are especially welcome, and the society has put up a small play corner by the gate.

sentences.speaker: Maya
sentences.text: Honestly, the best part is the bench someone carved from an old apple tree.

sentences.speaker: Owen
sentences.text: Hannah from the parish council says the next open day is in May.

sentences.speaker: Maya
sentences.text: All the details will be posted on the noticeboard outside the library.

sentences.speaker: Owen
sentences.text: Dates and times for the seed swap are still being confirmed, so keep an eye out.

sentences.speaker: Maya
sentences.text: If you cannot make it on Saturday, the society says a few plots will stay open until Sunday.

sentences.speaker: Owen
sentences.text: Cuttings and bulbs are also being given away free to anyone who asks.

sentences.speaker: Maya
sentences.text: Nobody needs a big garden to take part, just a bit of patience.

sentences.speaker: Owen
sentences.text: Officially the site has reopened after a long refurbishment of the water system.

sentences.speaker: Maya
sentences.text: Careful pruning of the old raspberry canes is on the list for next week.

sentences.speaker: Owen
sentences.text: Walking tours of the site are planned for later in the summer.

sentences.speaker: Maya
sentences.text: Once the tours are confirmed, the society will post them online too.

sentences.speaker: Owen
sentences.text: Winter squash, runner beans and a few stubborn leeks are already growing well.

sentences.speaker: Maya
sentences.text: Whoever planted those leeks last autumn deserves a medal for patience.

sentences.speaker: Owen
sentences.text: People keep saying the first sunny weekend always brings the best turnout.

sentences.speaker: Maya
sentences.text: Children from the primary school planted sunflowers along the fence on Friday.

sentences.speaker: Owen
sentences.text: Nearly every bed has a new label now, written by the kids in bright marker pens.

sentences.speaker: Maya
sentences.text: Sadly the old scarecrow blew over in Tuesday's storm and needs rebuilding.

sentences.speaker: Owen
sentences.text: The committee has already agreed to give it a new hat.

sentences.speaker: Maya
sentences.text: Blackberry bushes along the eastern wall are finally getting trimmed back.

sentences.speaker: Owen
sentences.text: Dozens of volunteers turned up with loppers and gloves for the job.

sentences.speaker: Maya
sentences.text: Pretty much everyone agreed the morning ended with cake and a lot of mud.

sentences.speaker: Owen
sentences.text: Let us hope the weather holds for the next few weeks.

sentences.speaker: Maya
sentences.text: Odd as it sounds, the rain has been the biggest help so far.

sentences.speaker: Owen
sentences.text: Soon the wildflower strip by the car park should be in full bloom.

sentences.speaker: Maya
sentences.text: Plenty of bees have already moved in, which the society is thrilled about.

sentences.speaker: Owen
sentences.text: Locals can find the full timetable on the society's website this week.

sentences.speaker: Maya
sentences.text: Meanwhile the café by the station has promised to keep a pot of tea going all day.

sentences.speaker: Owen
sentences.text: Good news for anyone who likes a slice of cake after digging.

sentences.speaker: Maya
sentences.text: So that is the update from the allotments, and it sounds like a lovely start.

sentences.speaker: Owen
sentences.text: Cheers to the volunteers who made it happen, and see you down there.

sentences.speaker: Maya
sentences.text: Come along on Saturday and bring a pair of wellies.

outro.speaker: Owen
outro.text: Thanks for tuning in to the local news today.

outro.speaker: Maya
outro.text: Enjoy the sunshine, and mind the mud on the paths.
